summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the semiconductor process-control node. KLA is the obvious reference leader across wafer, reticle, IC, packaging, and PCB process control. The underfollowed lane should prioritize Camtek, Onto Innovation, and Nova because they have more concentrated inspection/metrology exposure to advanced packaging, wafer-level packaging, inline process control, or yield-management workflows that become more valuable as AI accelerators, HBM, chiplets, and substrates increase manufacturing complexity. No buy/sell view is implied.
